changelog:
- Initial release: Extracts structured product listings from any Amazon search results or category browse page across all regional Amazon sites.
- Returns per-item product cards with details like ASIN, title, URL, image, prices, star rating, review count, badges (Amazon's Choice, Best Seller), sponsorship, delivery info, social proof, and position index.
- Provides pagination info: current page, next page URL, hasNextPage, and approximate total results.
- Supports full pagination, including walking through multi-page search/category results (within Amazon’s known page limit where applicable).
- Works directly in the user's browser session and never bypasses authentication or access controls.
- Suitable for use cases like price monitoring, competitive tracking, keyword ranking analysis, category audits, and bulk ASIN extraction.
summary: Amazon search and category listing scraper: extract product listings from any Amazon search results page, keyword search URL, or category browse page and return per-item cards (asin, title, url, image, price, listPrice, stars, reviewCount, badges, isAmazonChoice, isBestSeller, isSponsored, delivery,
